name: Series 10 Smartwatch
subtitle: Large Display Bluetooth Calling Watch
description: Series 10 Smartwatch features a 2.09-inch LCD TFT display, Bluetooth calling, wireless charging, heart rate monitoring, sleep tracking, multiple sports modes, and smart notifications. Its black 45 mm case and silicone strap make it suitable for everyday use with Android and iOS smartphones.
story: Designed around everyday wrist convenience, the Series 10 Smartwatch combines a large display with phone-connected features for calls, messages, and app alerts. Bluetooth calling lets you use the built-in microphone and speaker while your phone stays nearby. Heart rate and sleep tracking provide general wellness information, while multiple activity modes support routine workouts. Wireless charging simplifies recharging, and the listed battery backup of up to 3–5 days helps reduce how often the watch needs to be powered.
shipping: Estimated delivery in around 7 days. Delivery may arrive earlier or take longer depending on your destination and carrier.
